items.title: The team behind Tailwind CSS is joining Shopify
items.blurb: We're joining Shopify to give Tailwind a stable long-term home where it will be actively maintained for the millions of people who depend on it.

items.title: Twenty Years of jQuery: How a Little Library Rewired Web Development
items.blurb: jQuery, created by John Resig and released in 2006, is a JavaScript library that simplifies HTML manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax. It enabled easier web development by providing an accessible API across browsers.

items.title: Antiquated HTML Snippets and Artefacts
items.blurb: Overviews of the very many snippets of HTML that were once commonly included on websites to address specific cases with certain technologies, browsers, operating systems, or extensions.

items.title: New Things You Should Know About HTML in 2026
items.blurb: You've got your permissions elements, custom element registries, a potential future for HTML includes, HTML-in-Canvas, and a bunch more.

items.title: The Best Dark Mode Toggle is Probably… None
items.blurb: My post on two-state dark mode toggles sparked a lot of discussion about the optimal dark mode toggle design. But should you have a (persistent) dark mode toggle at all? I have since been convinced that for most websites, the answer is no.
